title: Path of Exile 2 - Player Lexicon & Synonym Dictionary
description: Isolated mapping dictionary used strictly for pre-retrieval query normalization. Kept separate from general LLM prompt context to keep core knowledge files pure.

mappings.notes: Players universally use 'maps' and 'mapping' to describe running Waystones on the Atlas.
Equipment sockets used exclusively for Runes and Soul Cores (rolled via Artificer's Orbs). Distinct from skill gem sockets.
The umbrella game term encompassing both basic Runes and rare endgame Soul Cores.
Currency used to add Augment Sockets to weapons and armour (up to 2 for body armour/2H weapons; 1 for 1H/helm/gloves/boots).
Loot item right-clicked to open the Gemcutting menu to carve any skill/support of that level tier.
Dedicated 100-base persistent resource pool. Completely separate from Mana.
Auxiliary items placed into the Map Device alongside Waystones to force league encounters.
Atlas landmark encounter that permanently clears the Fog of War and drops a Precursor Tablet.
Rolls when an attack bypasses Evasion to mitigate a significant portion of incoming damage.
Non-tradable dropped currency used for vendor passive respecs, vendor mystery gambling, and trade market fees.
